summary: Frontend-only testing of the new DIY Calculators feature. ALL 7 calculator hub categories render, search filters correctly (typing 'deck' isolates the deck card), 12+ cards open their dedicated pages. Paint calc matches expected values: 12x12x8 / 1 door / 2 windows / 2 coats => 333 sq ft + 1.9 gal (and live-updates to 461 sq ft / 2.6 gal when length=20). Select-type chips work on Roofing (default 6/12 -> 1342 sq ft, switching to 12/12 -> 1697 sq ft) and Deck (16OC -> 10 joists, 24OC -> 7 joists). Spot-checked flooring, tile, concrete-slab, fence, drywall — all load, compute, and render SHOPPING LIST. Entry points: home banner testID=home-calculators navigates to /calculators; hamburger menu (testID=home-menu opens drawer) item testID=menu-calculators also navigates to /calculators; PAINT STUDIO banner still present alongside DIY CALCULATORS banner on home. Contextual popup tested on demo user's existing project 'Fix a loose doorknob': calculatorForProject matches 'knob' keyword -> Cabinet Hardware Calculator. Banner (testID=project-calc-banner) shows, tapping opens the bottom-sheet (testID=calc-sheet-close present), Cabinet Hardware compute renders, live-update works (drawers 8->15 -> total 35), close button closes the sheet. HOWEVER: there is a JSX/rendering bug on the project guide screen — every render logs 'Unexpected text node: )}. A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' — caused by an orphan `)}` at /app/frontend/app/project/[id].tsx:305, indicating the inserted banner/CalculatorSheet block broke a wrapping `{g && (<>...</>)}` block. Also: the keyword 'knob' is too broad (matches 'doorknob' and would also match any title containing 'knob', wrongly opening the Cabinet Hardware calc). Minor icon warning: 'deck' is not a valid material-community icon name (Deck Calculator card).

ui_bugs.issue: Orphan `)}` token at line 305 renders as a text node — every project page render emits the React error: 'Unexpected text node: )}. A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.'. The CalculatorSheet/banner insertion broke a wrapping conditional fragment (likely `{g && (<>...</>)}`). Visual layout still works but the error fires on every navigation to a project.

Keyword 'knob' (under cabinet-hardware) is too broad — matches 'doorknob' so the demo project 'Fix a loose doorknob' wrongly surfaces the Cabinet Hardware Calculator banner. Tighten to 'cabinet knob' / 'cabinet pull' to avoid false positives.

icon: 'deck' triggers MaterialCommunityIcons warning: '"deck" is not a valid icon name for family "material-community"'. Card on hub renders as a placeholder ?-icon. Use a valid name e.g. 'floor-plan', 'pier', 'home-floor-0' or 'wall'.

react_native_issues.issue: Orphan `)}` rendered as raw JSX text -> 'Unexpected text node: )}. A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/project/[id].tsx:305 (context: lines 268-305). Likely fix: wrap TOOLS&MATERIALS + banner + CalculatorSheet + SAFETY FIRST in `{g && (<>...</>)}` and remove the dangling `)}`.

action_items: Fix orphan `)}` at /app/frontend/app/project/[id].tsx:305 — re-wrap the TOOLS&MATERIALS / banner / CalculatorSheet / SAFETY FIRST block in `{g && (<>...</>)}` and remove the dangling `)}`. This is the root cause of the 'Unexpected text node' warning fired on every project page render.

Narrow the cabinet-hardware keyword list in /app/frontend/src/calculators/registry.ts:639 from ['cabinet hardware','knob','pull'] to ['cabinet hardware','cabinet knob','cabinet pull','drawer pull'] so a 'Fix a loose doorknob' project doesn't open the Cabinet Hardware calculator.

Replace icon 'deck' in CALCULATORS[deck] in /app/frontend/src/calculators/registry.ts:204 with a valid MaterialCommunityIcons name (e.g. 'floor-plan', 'pier', or 'home-floor-0') — currently logs an invalid-icon warning and renders the placeholder question-mark glyph.
critical_code_review_comments: Project guide page has structural JSX damage: the conditional `{g && (<>...</>)}` block that originally wrapped TOOLS&MATERIALS and SAFETY FIRST is no longer closed properly after the contextual calc banner was inserted; only an orphan `)}` remains on line 305. This is purely cosmetic at runtime (RN keeps rendering) but emits an error on every render and is fragile.

calculatorForProject keyword matching is substring-based and unanchored, so generic words ('knob', 'fram', 'trim') can produce false matches against unrelated project titles. Consider word-boundary regex matching or longer keyphrases.
registry.ts: 'deck' is not a valid MaterialCommunityIcons name — would be worth adding a small dev-time validation that every CALCULATORS[*].icon resolves before shipping new entries.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (hub, search, paint formula, live updates, select chips, 5 spot-checks, entry-point banner, hamburger menu item, contextual sheet open/compute/close all PASS; project page renders the contextual banner correctly but logs an Unexpected-text-node React warning on every render)

rca_of_issue: RCA for orphan `)}` on project page: original JSX wrapped TOOLS&MATERIALS + SAFETY FIRST sections inside `{g && (<>...</>)}`. When the calculator banner + CalculatorSheet were inserted between the two Sections, the opening `{g && (<>` (or equivalent wrapping fragment) was removed but the closing `)}` on line 305 was not deleted. Result: React Native treats the bare `)}` as a child text node of the parent <View>, emitting the warning. Reproduction: log in as demo user, open any project from /projects — the warning fires immediately. Mitigation: restore the wrapping `{g && (<>...</>)}` block or rewrite as `{g && <Section ... />}{g && <CalculatorSheet ... />}{g && <Section ... />}` style without the orphan closer.
